stylePrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE ROOK exercise-library illustration. The supplied image is a STYLE reference only; do not copy its movement or machine. Draw the specified exercise correctly. Canonical style: clean refined technical line art, anatomically proportionate adult athlete in shorts and simple training shoes, moderate anatomy detail, precise clean apparatus, no sketchiness. Crisp smooth controlled medium-fine contours with slightly thinner interior lines. Restrained facial detail, no heavy dark filled areas. Single flat dark green #1f6b4c ink on a plain WHITE background (background is removed during the existing vector conversion). No gray, no shading, no hatching, no shadows, no gradients, no texture, no checkerboard, no text, no arrows, no numbers, no logos. Complete body and required equipment visible in a square composition, roughly 7% clear margin, centered. Three-quarter view where it clarifies movement/equipment. No extra people or unrelated equipment. Match detail level and visual weight of reference. One illustration only. Subject:

subjects.assisted-chin-up: Assisted chin-up using knee-pad counterweight machine, supinated hand grip, knees on moving support, body pulled upward. Keep assisted apparatus distinct from free chin-up.
subjects.band-pull-apart: Standing band pull-apart, both arms extended horizontally in front and spread apart, continuous taut elastic band between both hands, no external anchor.
subjects.banded-pallof-press: Standing Pallof press with elastic band anchored to side at chest height, two hands held together straight in front of torso resisting rotation, no cable machine.
subjects.banded-kickback: Standing elastic-band glute kickback, one foot supporting and other leg extended behind, band connected from working ankle to low fixed anchor, one hand lightly supporting on post.
subjects.belt-squat: Plate-loaded lever belt squat, athlete squatting upright on two platforms with waist belt connected down between legs to machine lever. Weight hangs from belt, NOT shoulders.
subjects.bent-over-rear-delt-raise: Standing bent-over dumbbell rear-delt raise, hip hinge and neutral spine, two dumbbells held with arms spread laterally and softly bent elbows.
subjects.cat-cow-stretch: Quadruped cat-cow mobility, palms under shoulders and knees under hips, gently rounded upper back in cat phase, neck follows spine, no equipment.
subjects.chest-supported-row: Chest-supported plate-loaded machine row, chest against inclined pad, feet grounded, both hands pulling handles toward ribs; machine levers and plates visible.
subjects.cycling: Indoor cycling on stationary spin bike, seated athlete with feet on pedals and hands on handlebar, connected bike frame and flywheel.
subjects.dumbbell-curtsy-lunge: Dumbbell curtsy lunge, one foot crossed diagonally behind planted support leg, both knees flexed, two dumbbells hanging beside torso.
subjects.dumbbell-glute-bridge: Floor dumbbell glute bridge, supine athlete with shoulders on floor and knees bent, feet planted, hips raised, ONE dumbbell secured by hands across hips. No bench.
subjects.dumbbell-hip-thrust: Dumbbell hip thrust, upper back on flat bench, feet planted, hips raised, one dumbbell held across hip crease. Distinct from floor glute bridge.
subjects.dumbbell-sumo-deadlift: Wide-stance dumbbell sumo deadlift, toes angled out, knees bent outward, upright neutral torso, two dumbbells held down between legs.
subjects.dumbbell-sumo-squat: Wide-stance dumbbell sumo squat, both hands holding one dumbbell vertically between thighs, knees flexed outward, feet planted wide.
subjects.face-pull: Standing cable face pull with rope attachment at face height, hands beside temples and elbows spread, cable leads horizontally to machine pulley.
subjects.frog-pump: Floor frog pump, supine on mat, soles of feet together and knees spread outward, heels near hips, glutes lifted. No band or added weight.
subjects.half-kneeling-pallof-press: Half-kneeling cable Pallof press, one knee on mat and opposite foot in front, both arms extended forward holding cable handle, cable pulls from the side at chest height.
subjects.high-knees: High-knees running drill, upright athlete with one knee raised to hip height, opposite arm forward, other foot under body, no equipment.
subjects.hip-abduction-machine: Seated hip abduction machine, back supported, thighs pushing outward against pads outside knees, feet on supports, connected weight-stack apparatus.
subjects.hip-airplane: Supported hip airplane balance drill, one leg planted with hip hinge, opposite leg extended straight behind, one hand lightly holding upright support and torso rotated open.
subjects.l-sit-hold: L-sit hold on parallel bars, straight arms supporting body, both legs together extended horizontally in front, hips flexed 90 degrees. Full bars and body.
subjects.landmine-press: Standing single-arm landmine press, one hand holding loaded barbell end at shoulder height and pushing diagonally upward; opposite bar end fixed in floor pivot.
subjects.leg-swings-stretch: Standing leg swing mobility, one hand supporting on rail, one foot planted and opposite straight leg swinging forward moderately, no weights or bands.
subjects.machine-lateral-raise: Seated machine lateral raise, back supported, elbows under lateral lifting pads and raised toward shoulder height; clear paired lever arms and weight stack.
subjects.mountain-climber: Mountain climber floor drill, straight-arm plank with one knee driven toward chest and opposite leg extended, palms under shoulders.
subjects.nordic-hamstring-curl: Nordic hamstring curl, knees on padded floor support and ankles secured under low fixed roller, straight body from knees to shoulders leaning forward, arms crossed. No hip hinge.
subjects.reverse-hyperextension: Reverse hyperextension on raised bench machine, torso supported prone, hands gripping front handles, BOTH legs extended behind and lifted to torso height; no back-extension chair.
subjects.reverse-pec-deck: Reverse pec deck rear-delt fly, seated facing machine pad, chest supported, arms opened laterally holding machine handles, weight stack behind machine.
subjects.rook-forward-single-leg-hops: Forward single-leg hop drill, athlete moving forward with one leg driving and opposite foot lifted, arms balanced, visible light airborne phase, no equipment.
subjects.rook-y-balance-reach: Y-balance reach test, one foot stable on center of Y-shaped floor lines, free foot reaching along one branch while support knee bends, hands at hips. No weights.
subjects.seated-dumbbell-press: Seated dumbbell shoulder press, upright backrest, one dumbbell in each hand above shoulder height with bent elbows, feet grounded.
subjects.shrimp-squat: Bodyweight shrimp squat, one leg supports a squat while free knee bends behind with same-side hand holding ankle, other hand reaches forward for balance. No weights.
subjects.single-arm-cable-row: Standing single-arm cable row, staggered feet, one hand pulls handle to ribs, horizontal cable from mid-height pulley and weight stack.
subjects.single-dumbbell-skullcrusher: Lying two-hand triceps extension with ONE dumbbell, supine on flat bench, upper arms upright and elbows flexed, both hands holding same dumbbell above/behind forehead.
subjects.single-leg-romanian-deadlift: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift, one support leg slightly bent, hips hinged, opposite straight leg extended behind, two dumbbells hanging under shoulders.
subjects.skierg: SkiErg exercise on upright ski ergometer, athlete pulling two overhead cable handles down beside hips with slight hip hinge, flywheel housing at machine base.
subjects.smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat: Smith-machine Bulgarian split squat, rear foot elevated on bench, front foot planted and knee bent, guided bar across upper back on vertical rails.
subjects.smith-machine-reverse-lunge: Smith-machine reverse lunge, guided bar across upper back, rear foot stepping backward on floor, front knee bent, full vertical rail frame. No rear-foot bench.
subjects.stair-climber: Athlete climbing a revolving stairmill with actual broad rotating steps, one foot higher than other and hands lightly on side rails. Not elliptical.
subjects.sumo-deadlift: Barbell sumo deadlift, very wide foot stance with toes outward, hands gripping straight bar INSIDE knees, knees bent outward and neutral spine.
subjects.torso-twist-stretch: Seated unweighted torso rotation stretch on floor, bent knees and grounded feet, torso turned gently to side, arms held loosely in front. No weight plate.
subjects.trap-bar-deadlift: Trap-bar deadlift, athlete standing INSIDE a hexagonal bar frame, hands holding side handles at hips, bent knees and neutral spine; plates on lateral sleeves.
subjects.weighted-push-up: Weighted floor push-up with a single weight plate securely resting across upper back, palms and toes grounded, straight body and bent elbows. Plate is on back, not hips.
subjects.wide-grip-lat-pulldown: Wide pronated-grip lat pulldown, athlete seated with thighs secured, hands near ends of long wide bar pulled to upper chest, overhead cable and stack.
subjects.leg-press: Bilateral 45-degree sled leg press, seated and back supported, BOTH feet on the platform, knees moderately bent; complete plate-loaded sled and rails.
subjects.barbell-row: Bent-over barbell row, two hands pronated on a straight bar below ribs, hip hinge, stable bent knees, flat neutral back.
subjects.bench-dip: Bench dip, hands gripping the bench behind the hips, feet on the floor in front, elbows flexed, shoulders controlled. Not a parallel-bar dip.
subjects.bench-press: Flat barbell bench press with athlete supine on a flat bench, feet grounded, both hands on straight bar slightly above chest; clearly flat bench and rack.
subjects.cable-curl: Standing two-hand straight-bar cable biceps curl, low pulley and connected cable weight stack visible, elbows at sides, forearms flexed.
subjects.cable-fly: Standing bilateral cable chest fly, split stance, both hands holding separate cable handles in front of chest, soft elbows, two side cable towers.
subjects.cable-kickback: Standing cable glute kickback, one ankle cuff connected to LOW pulley, that leg extended behind, opposite support leg planted, hands stabilizing on tower.
subjects.chin-up: Chin-up at a straight overhead bar, palms facing athlete (supinated grip), elbows flexed and chin above bar; full body and bar frame visible.
subjects.close-grip-bench-press: Close-grip flat barbell bench press, supine with feet grounded, hands shoulder-width apart on bar and elbows close to torso; flat bench and rack.
subjects.close-grip-lat-pulldown: Seated close-grip lat pulldown using narrow neutral-grip V handle, thighs under restraint, handle pulled toward upper chest, overhead cable and stack visible.
subjects.concentration-curl: Seated single-arm dumbbell concentration curl, upper arm braced against inner thigh, one dumbbell lifted by elbow flexion, free hand resting on opposite knee.
subjects.deadlift: Conventional barbell deadlift, feet hip width, hands outside knees gripping bar close to shins, bar around mid-shin, neutral spine and bent knees. No platform.
subjects.dip: Bodyweight parallel-bar dip, hands on bars beside hips, elbows flexed, body suspended and feet clear of floor. No bench.
subjects.dumbbell-bench-press: Flat dumbbell bench press, supine on flat bench, feet planted, two independent dumbbells just above chest, elbows bent. No barbell.
subjects.dumbbell-fly: Flat dumbbell chest fly, supine on flat bench, both arms opened laterally with softly bent elbows, one dumbbell in each hand.
subjects.dumbbell-overhead-tricep-extension: Seated two-hand overhead triceps extension with ONE dumbbell held behind head by both hands, elbows pointing up, torso upright on bench.
subjects.dumbbell-shrug: Standing bilateral dumbbell shrug, one dumbbell hanging in each straight arm beside thighs, shoulders elevated, neutral torso.
subjects.dumbbell-skull-crusher: Lying dumbbell triceps extension on a flat bench, one dumbbell in each hand near sides of forehead, upper arms upright, elbows flexed, feet grounded.
subjects.ez-bar-curl: Standing EZ-bar biceps curl, BOTH hands gripping visibly angled zigzag EZ bar, elbows near sides, forearms flexed. Not a straight bar.
subjects.front-raise: Standing dumbbell front raise, two dumbbells lifted in front to shoulder height, elbows softly bent, stable upright torso.
subjects.good-morning: Barbell good morning, bar securely across upper back, hip hinge with torso inclined forward, knees slightly bent, neutral spine.
subjects.incline-bench-press: Incline barbell bench press, bench backrest clearly inclined about 30 degrees, feet planted, straight bar held above upper chest with elbows bent.
subjects.incline-dumbbell-press: Incline dumbbell bench press, supported on bench backrest about 30 degrees, feet grounded, two dumbbells at upper chest with elbows bent.
subjects.inverted-row: Bodyweight inverted row under a waist-high fixed horizontal bar on a rack, heels grounded, straight body slanted, chest drawn toward bar. Not hanging vertical pull-up.
subjects.lat-pulldown: Seated wide overhand-grip lat pulldown, thighs secured below knee pad, wide bar at upper chest, upright torso, overhead cable and weight-stack machine.
subjects.lateral-raise: Standing bilateral dumbbell lateral raise, arms raised to sides about shoulder height, slight elbow bend, dumbbell in each hand.
subjects.leg-curl: Prone lying machine leg curl, torso supported face down on angled bench, knees bent to lift padded ankle roller toward glutes; machine resistance linkage visible.
subjects.neutral-grip-pull-up: Neutral-grip pull-up, palms facing each other on TWO short parallel overhead handles, elbows flexed, body suspended. Handle direction must show neutral grip.
subjects.pull-up: Overhand pull-up, palms facing away on horizontal bar, hands wider than shoulders, elbows flexed, chin above bar and body suspended.
subjects.push-up: Standard floor push-up, palms around shoulder width, toes grounded, straight trunk and legs, elbows flexed with chest just above floor.
subjects.reverse-lunge: Dumbbell reverse lunge, one leg stepping backward into lunge, front foot planted flat, rear heel raised, rear knee near floor; one dumbbell by each side.
subjects.romanian-deadlift: Barbell Romanian deadlift, standing hip hinge, slight knee bend, bar close to legs below knees, hips pushed back, neutral spine. Not conventional deep-knee deadlift.
subjects.rook-band-fly: Standing resistance-band chest fly, band anchored securely behind athlete at chest height, both hands move together in front with soft elbows. Show elastic bands and anchor; NO cable tower or weight stack.
subjects.rook-band-leg-curl: Prone resistance-band leg curl on exercise mat, elastic band anchored low beyond feet and looped at ankles, knees flexed to curl heels toward glutes. NO machine or weighted roller.
subjects.rook-band-triceps-pressdown: Standing resistance-band triceps pressdown, elastic band anchored above head on simple fixed support, both hands pressing down beside hips, elbows tucked. NO cable machine or weight stack.
subjects.rook-barbell-curl: Standing straight-barbell biceps curl, both hands supinated on a STRAIGHT bar, elbows close to torso, forearms flexed. No EZ-bar.
subjects.rope-hammer-curl: Standing low-cable rope hammer curl, rope ends held with neutral grip, elbows close to sides, cable from low pulley, rope and stack visible.
subjects.rope-tricep-pushdown: Standing high-cable rope triceps pushdown, rope ends held separately beside hips, elbows tucked, connected cable from overhead pulley and stack.
subjects.skull-crusher: Lying EZ-bar skull crusher on flat bench, both hands on angled EZ bar above forehead, elbows flexed, upper arms pointing up and feet planted.
subjects.smith-machine-bench-press: Flat bench press inside Smith machine: bar guided on two vertical rails, supine athlete with grounded feet, both hands pressing guided bar above chest.
subjects.smith-machine-squat: Smith-machine squat, guided bar across upper back on two vertical rails, feet flat, knees and hips flexed in controlled squat, complete machine frame.
subjects.spider-curl: Spider curl with EZ bar, torso supported FACE DOWN on incline bench, arms hanging in front of bench then elbow flexion lifting bar, feet planted. Not preacher curl.
subjects.step-up: Dumbbell step-up onto sturdy knee-height box, front foot fully planted on box, body rising with opposite leg trailing, one dumbbell beside each hip.
subjects.tricep-pushdown: Standing straight-bar cable triceps pushdown, both hands on short straight bar at hips, elbows tucked, connected overhead pulley and weight stack.
subjects.upright-row: Standing barbell upright row, straight bar raised to lower chest, elbows leading outward/up above hands, balanced upright torso.
subjects.wall-walk: Wall walk bodyweight exercise: hands planted on floor near wall, feet braced high on wall, torso near vertical in supported inverted position. Full body and simple wall plane, no apparatus.
